newsitem.title: USA: Gaylord Container Q4 hurt by lower prices.
newsitem.headline: Gaylord Container Q4 hurt by lower prices.

text.p: Gaylord Container Corp said Wednesday a $9.7-million loss in the first quarter of fiscal 1997, ended December 31, was primarily caused by lower average selling prices for its products.
The company said the lower prices reduced operating earnings by $55 million versus the first quarter of fiscal 1996, when they reached $52.3 million.
Gaylord Container said the loss of $9.7 million compared to net income of $16.5 million one year ago. Sales were $195.6 million, down from $253.8 million in 1996.
The 1996 figure also included a $2.6-million loss for the early retirement of $65 million of debt securities.
Gaylord Container makes corrugated boxes and other paper products. Its shares were trading off 3/16 Wednesday at 6-3/8.
